title: Plant Developmental Cell Death: Xylem, Tapetum and Tissue Remodeling
topic: Programmed Cell Death, Aging and Senescence in Animals and Plants
word_count_method: Unicode word tokens with internal apostrophes/hyphens in saved p.teaching-prose only. Excludes headings, figures, tables, practice, worked examples, revision and references. Article count excludes SVG title/desc.
scope: Official revised CSIR LS&BT Unit 5.E, separate CSIR LS Unit 5.E and mirrored MP SET Unit 5.E; Academy node-specific interpretation.

dimensions.C: Wall chemistry, vacuoles, sporopollenin, proteins, membranes
dimensions.D: Preparation, execution, autolysis and tissue-specific regulation
dimensions.E: Energetics, enzyme catalysis, inhibition, pressure flow and diffusion
dimensions.F: Transcription, inhibition, tissue competence, ethylene and redox
dimensions.G: Hydraulic derivation, binding equilibrium, population balance and diffusion
dimensions.H: Staged comparisons, mutants, rescue, marker limitations
dimensions.I: Transport, fertility, embryo support, tissue homeostasis and aeration
dimensions.J: Angiosperm species examples, root-cap shedding and animal comparison
dimensions.K: VND, EAT1, MYB80, NtCYS, SMB, BFN1 and ethylene perturbations
dimensions.L: Postmortem lignification, hypophysis exception, marker limitations
dimensions.O: 54 original questions with quantitative and figure interpretation

findings: Official CSIR scope and roadmap checked; SET mirror limitation.
